name: Template A: New Technical Institution / Letter of Approval (LoA)
aphSourceReference: Approval Process Handbook 2024–2027 Chapter I, Clauses 1.1 to 1.12
description: Comprehensive regulatory pathway for granting Letter of Approval (LoA) to newly established technical institutions. Mandates 100% document scrutiny, physical Expert Visit Committee (EVC) verification, and Council approval.
statutoryConstraints: Registered lease must meet minimum 30-year unexpired duration as per Clause 1.10
Physical EVC inspection is non-waivable for all new institutions
Statutory decision must be signed by Member Secretary / Council Authority
Speaking order of rejection triggers statutory 7-day SAC appeal window under Clause 2.24(a)
